The flagship for news around the universe. Adults 21+. For entertainment purposes only.

3. Reuters | A Reuters investigation found Iran and its allies deliberately hit water plants, airports, refineries and a nuclear power station across the Persian Gulf, counting at least 135 drone and missile strikes on at least 84 infrastructure sites in seven Gulf countries since February 28, repeatedly striking the equipment each facility could least afford to lose.

Reuters | Trump's effort to lower energy prices via a US-Russia diesel deal drew friction with Italy's Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, who called it a 'very risky choice' that could undermine pressure on Moscow, while Zelenskyy accused Trump of choosing the wrong side and handing Putin an easy victory.

11. BBC Sky at Night Magazine | The James Webb Space Telescope directly imaged Epsilon Indi Ab, a super-Jupiter several times Jupiter's mass just 12 light-years away and one of the coldest exoplanets ever directly seen at about 2 degrees Celsius, in a system resembling our own solar system.
12. BBC | The death toll from a school roof collapse in Pakistan rose to at least 33 pupils and a teacher killed, with children buried under debris after the roof crashed through three classrooms, police said — a sharp rise from the 17 students first reported this morning.
